premises.text: Employment software is not built for deskless workers or for employers to meet their needs
premises.evidence_span: employers have no structure or no setup to meet the needs of these deskless workers

premises.text: Antil is a text-based two-way support portal with auto FAQ replies, translation, turnover prediction, and auto-populated job data
premises.evidence_span: Our system enables access to the software, replies to FAQs automatically, translates into over 110 languages, predicts turnover, and populates employee job data automatically

premises.text: Mutual trust that reduces turnover requires first providing access to communication between employees and employers
premises.evidence_span: The mutual trust is the core component of reducing turnover. However, to build trust, we first need to provide access to that communication

domains.name: Text support portal bridging both sides

value.text: Improve organizational retention of deskless workers

secondary_value.text: Complete inclusivity of the entire workforce including factory, delivery, and store workers
